edition.notes: The 1921 Benziger Brothers printing, bearing the imprimaturs of John Cardinal McCloskey (New York, 6 April 1885), Michael Augustine [Corrigan] (New York, 21 February 1901), and Patrick J. Hayes (New York, 29 June 1921), with Archbishop James Gibbons's approval of 6 April 1885, and copyright lines of 1885 (Spalding), 1901 (Kinkead), and 1921 (Benziger Brothers). Published in the United States in 1921 and therefore public domain in the United States. Catalog-level record: no exact artifact bytes are retained here. A complete page-imaged exemplar is publicly delivered by the Internet Archive as item catechismofchris00unse; consumers collating prayer texts record the exact leaves inspected locally.
edition.title: Baltimore Catechism No. 3 (New York: Benziger Brothers, 1921)

work.author: Third Plenary Council of Baltimore
work.description: The graded No. 3 catechism of the Baltimore series descending from the catechism approved by Archbishop James Gibbons on 6 April 1885 as ordered by the Third Plenary Council of Baltimore. Its opening Prayers section prints the received English texts of the Lord's Prayer, the Angelical Salutation (Hail Mary), the Apostles' Creed, and other common prayers; the Doxology and the Rosary are treated in the question-and-answer lessons. Cited by printed page and question number.
work.title: A Catechism of Christian Doctrine, Prepared and Enjoined by Order of the Third Plenary Council of Baltimore, No. 3
